text: {"assertions":["A silent drop bug was discovered in notifications/push/dispatch.py when two requests raced on the same key.","The bug caused sends to report success while no actual delivery occurred.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The fix removed the listener on teardown and added a test assertion to prevent regression.","The bug could be reproduced by dispatching to a device token that had been rotated.","A fix was submitted in PR #6795 on branch fix/silent-drop-1.","After implementing the fix, the error rate decreased from 7.9% to under 4 per 10,000."]}
